name: De Montfort University
description: De Montfort University is located in the city of Leicester. Until 1992, it was known as Leicester Technical School, founded in 1969. The University's only campus is Leicester City Campus. Leicester is just 1 hour from London by train and easily accessible within the UK, while Paris is just 3 hours. It has approximately 20,500 registered students. The curriculum is conducted under four faculties: Faculty of Art, Design, and Humanities; Faculty of Business and Law; Faculty of Technology; Faculty of Health and Life Sciences. There are eight student dormitories on the campus in the city center.
